entities.name: Surrak Dragonclaw
entities.description: A young Temur warrior who fights a bear in the wilds, is scarred, rises to lead clan fighters and is named khan; he later wears the bear's hide and paws.

entities.name: Temur
entities.description: A clan of reverent, pragmatic mountain people whose khan is not hereditary.

entities.name: Sultai
entities.description: A hated clan whose raiders and serpent masters, with zombie thralls, harry Temur camps.

entities.name: Abzan
entities.description: A clan from whose beast Surrak's claw gloves were crafted.

entities.name: The One Who Whispers Twice
entities.description: The clan elder who gives Surrak a greatspear and later speaks the invocation naming him First Father of the Temur.

entities.name: The Whisperers
entities.description: The Temur spiritual elders who say Surrak's battle cry was once screamed by dragons.

entities.name: Cave Bear
entities.description: A huge bear that Surrak fights and defeats, which later charges to his aid against the Sultai before being slain by him at its plea.

entities.name: Dragonclaw
entities.description: The ancestral Temur claw that the khan lifts overhead.

entities.name: Karakyk
entities.description: The great camp of the Temur to which Surrak returns after fighting the bear.

events.summary: Young Surrak enters a dark cave and has a vision of beasts on the ceiling and a human fighting a bear and winning with a double-bladed staff.
events.quote: Look now, young one , it seemed to say, although it held no words.

events.summary: Surrak follows the inward chant to the wilds and tracks a giant bear in the snow.
events.quote: Each print was as big around as the youth's waist, driven deep into the snow.

events.summary: Surrak fights the huge bear bare-handed with his claw gloves, is smashed and scarred and loses an eye, but wins by punching it and tearing at its neck until it retreats.
events.quote: Finally it dropped its gaze and turned aside.

events.summary: Surrak returns to Karakyk with trophies and is given the rights of the grown and a greatspear by the elders.
events.quote: They acknowledged the gifts and bestowed on Surrak the rights and titles of the grown.

events.summary: Surrak leads a growing band of clan fighters, soon second only to the Dragonclaw and Hunt Caller in blades.
events.quote: From that day, he led clan fighters to hunt both game and foes.

events.summary: Weary from pursuing Sultai raiders, Surrak's party catches a group of scavengers and shambling dead under three serpent-folk, including their own lost clansfolk.
events.quote: The Temur spat curses as they recognized the emaciated forms of their own clansfolk, lost to hunger and disease.

events.summary: Outnumbered Temur are overrun until the cave bear bursts in and rips through the Sultai ranks to Surrak's side, turning the battle.
events.quote: The cave bear crashed into the ranks of the Sultai, ripping apart the gaunt zombies

events.summary: After the Temur victory, Surrak sends the dying poisoned bear to the ancestors with the ancient chant and kills it with his spear.
events.quote: Then he stood and drove his spear through the beast's skull.

events.summary: He Who Whispers Twice marks Surrak as the First Father of the Temur, giving him a bearskin cloak and gauntlets made from the bear's paws.
events.quote: He Who Whispers Twice spoke the invocation that marked Surrak as the First Father of the Temur.

relations.note: Surrak becomes khan of the Temur.
relations.quote: Perhaps you've seen Surrak Dragonclaw, the khan of the Temur clan.

relations.note: The Sultai raid and harry Temur camps.
relations.quote: Raiding parties from other clans, and especially the hated Sultai, continually harried the camps

relations.note: The bear he once fought comes to his aid as an ally.
relations.quote: Surrak laughed in welcome for his old challenger, his new ally.

relations.note: Surrak ends the dying bear's life at its plea.
relations.quote: Then he stood and drove his spear through the beast's skull.

relations.note: He was once a young Temur warrior.
relations.quote: He was once just another young Temur warrior trying to make a name for himself.
